review_candidates.title: Implementation Manager – Revenue Cycle
review_candidates.description: About The Auctus Group LLC Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work . Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that. Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if: you like a fast-paced environment, you thrive with change and development, you like giving feedback, you’re a team player, you love learning/sleuthing, you’re big on accountability. Department: Operations / RCM (Client Services) Job level: Manager The Implementation Manager leads onboarding and integration of new dermatology and plastic surgery practices into our revenue cycle operations. You will combine hands-on medical billing expertise with project management to coordinate system setup, billing workflows, team readiness, client communication, and post-launch stabilization, so every practice goes live accurately and on time. As we grow, including through acquisitions, this role helps new practices move into consistent, scalable operations and protects billing quality from day one. About Us The Auctus Group is a specialty billing company serving dermatology, plastic surgery, and aesthetic practices. We are part of ProCode, which builds technology and AI tools for healthcare revenue cycle management. We handle Protected Health Information every day, so we hold ourselves to high standards for security, quality, and compliance. What You Will Do Lead implementations end to end. Own each new practice launch from discovery and planning through system setup, workflow design, go-live, and post-launch support. Be the revenue cycle expert. Apply hands-on knowledge of charge capture, CPT and ICD-10 coding, claims submission, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, and patient billing to every implementation. Coordinate across teams. Work with Billing, Coding, Business Intelligence, Training, and Operations to complete onboarding requirements and confirm each practice is ready to go live. Manage risk. Identify and reduce risks in payer enrollment and setup, credentialing, authorizations, billing workflows, and data or process handoffs. Set up the right tools. Oversee the configuration and use of practice management and billing tools, including ProCollect, electronic medical records, and clearinghouses. Be the client's main contact. Manage expectations, decisions, timelines, issues, and status updates throughout the implementation. Build a repeatable process. Develop and maintain standardized implementation plans, documentation, checklists, procedures, and best practices. Stabilize after go-live. Monitor billing performance, resolve launch issues, and coordinate corrective actions until operations are steady. What You Bring 5+ years of medical billing and revenue cycle management experience, with a strong hands-on understanding of operational billing workflows Proven experience leading practice implementations, client onboarding, or complex operational process transitions Deep understanding of payer rules and reimbursement, denial and appeal processes, insurance verification, authorizations, and claims operations Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to manage multiple implementations at once Excellent client-facing communication and cross-functional collaboration skills in a remote work environment Nice to have Experience with dermatology and/or plastic surgery billing Experience supporting multi-entity or multi-specialty organizations, particularly through practice acquisitions or integrations A continuous-improvement mindset, including Lean principles or experience standardizing scalable processes How Success Is Measured On-time, successful practice go-lives, with implementation milestones met Lower post-implementation billing error rates, with healthy clean-claim and denial-rate performance A positive client onboarding experience and timely issue resolution A short time to stabilize accounts receivable and overall revenue cycle performance after launch Compensation And Details Background screening is required for all Auctus Group team members, including new hires, because of our work with PHI.

Verksamheten i regionen är organiserad i fyra polisområden: Nord, City, Syd och Gotland som tillsammans är indelade i 19 lokalpolisområden. Vidare finns det fyra regionala enheter: gränspolisen, operativa enheten, underrättelseenheten och utredningsenheten, ett regionkansli samt nationella avdelningar som finns representerade i regionen för att ge stöd till polisverksamheten. Gränspolisenheten är en regional enhet vid region Stockholm som arbetar med gränskontroller, inre utlänningskontroller, verkställigheter av beslut om avvisning och utvisning, spaning och utredning avseende människosmuggling, brott mot utlänningslagen samt gränsöverskridande internationell organiserad brottslighet inom Stockholms län och Gotland. Gränspolisenheten har det regionala ansvaret för internationella kontakter vad gäller bland annat gränspolisfrågor, underrättelser och efterlysningar. Inom kansliet på gränspolisenheten återfinns fyra kansligrupper. Kansliet stödjer enhetsledning, sektioner och LPO Arlanda med beredning, planering och uppföljning av verksamheten samt kompetensförsörjning, IT- och beredskapssamordning.
